title: The Thim Kit for Elementor – Pre-built Templates & Widgets for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored…
description: The Thim Kit for Elementor plugin for WordPress contains a stored DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'comment' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 1.4.8. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary scripts. Exploitation requires the Post Comment widget with the Text Reveal entrance animation on a Single Post template, with the comment widget visible in the initial viewport. Once an attacker’s comment is approved or if moderation is disabled, the malicious script executes automatically for every visitor to the affected page.
